note: Charters the agents propose for the bot groups that already exist (bots' department labels). The owner decides each one on the agenda, with its budget ceiling (scripts/firm.mjs). Editing a charter here changes only future proposals.

desk.name: Trading desk
desk.mandate: Runs the organisation's paper-trading members: turns tested rules and model research into proposals, under the deterministic review, the release gate and the loss brakes. Judged by live paper fitness against holding all shares equally.

research.name: Research
research.mandate: Finds and tests what the desk could trade: daily trend research, the debate desk's bull and bear cases, R&D ideas and their forward tests. Judged by whether its calls and findings beat chance on later data.
